plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and repeat donor insights

panels.title: Total Donations (₹)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Repeat Donors (%)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN donor_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor"), 1) AS repeat_percentage FROM (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donor_count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1)

panels.title: Avg. Donation (₹)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Amount), 2) AS avg_donation FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend (₹)
panels.sql: SELECT DATE("Date", 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 5 Donation Cities (₹)
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM(Amount) AS city_total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Payment Mode Distribution (%)
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM(Amount) AS mode_total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Repeat Donors (Transactions)
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
